label: race-merge
sql: MERGE INTO client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.manifest_race_conflicting_r365 t USING (SELECT :id publication_id,:text descriptor_json,:digest descriptor_sha256) s ON t.publication_id=s.publication_id WHEN MATCHED AND (t.descriptor_json<>s.descriptor_json OR t.descriptor_sha256<>s.descriptor_sha256) THEN UPDATE SET descriptor_json=CAST(raise_error('ASHLAR_PUBLICATION_ID_CONFLICT') AS STRING) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (publication_id,descriptor_json,descriptor_sha256) VALUES(s.publication_id,s.descriptor_json,s.descriptor_sha256)
